plugin.name: IntelEngine
plugin.description:
AI-powered NPC autonomy mod for Skyrim, powered by SkyrimNet's LLM integration. Player FAQ: Data\IntelEngine Tools\FAQ.md
Features: - Player-directed NPC tasks (GoToLocation, FetchPerson, DeliverMessage, SearchForActor, ScheduleMeeting, EscortTarget) - LLM Dungeon Master story events (seek_player, informant, road_encounter, ambush, stalker, message, quest) - Autonomous NPC social interactions (npc_interaction, npc_gossip) - All features configurable via MCM
Requirements: - SKSE - SkyrimNet Beta 25 or newer - PapyrusExtender (po3) - PapyrusUtil - MCM Helper - Papyrus MessageBox - SKSE NG (Skyrim 1.6 and earlier) OR PapyrusMessageBox-1.7.104 (Skyrim 1.7)

plugin.name: Legacy save converter
plugin.description:
New game? Skip this! Playthrough from IntelEngine 3.5.2 or earlier? Tick "Legacy save converter". Help and warnings: FAQ.md in the "IntelEngine Tools" folder.
After installing: 1. Close Skyrim and back up the save's .ess and .skse. 2. Drag the .ess onto Convert-IE-Save.bat in "IntelEngine Tools" (MO2: right-click IntelEngine → Open in Explorer). 3. Start Skyrim and load the new "..._IEconverted" save.
